answer: Agents stake capital into a shared Verkle commitment inlet, where each identity leaf must post a distinct polynomial opening bound to a saffron-coded epoch tag, preventing duplicate registrations without revealing full state. Stateless validators sample these openings via constant-size witnesses, so a sybil cluster collapses as fable once its forged leaves fail. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
